summary: Architecture for an AI-powered hackathon networking matchmaker featuring organizer data ingestion, interactive conversational profiling, pgvector-based similarity and complementary matching, dynamic graph visualization, and QR-triggered LLM icebreaker generation.

nodes.label: Participant Web App
nodes.description: Mobile-first PWA providing conversational onboarding chat, interactive 2D interest graph explorer, QR badge scanner, and recommendation feed.

nodes.label: API Gateway & Router
nodes.description: Handles authentication, participant routing, QR code resolution, and coordinates profile chat sessions.

nodes.label: Organizer Data Ingest Worker
nodes.description: Ingests baseline registration rosters and survey CSVs from platforms like Luma, Devpost, or Airtable into staging tables.

nodes.label: Conversational Profiler Service
nodes.description: Orchestrates multi-turn dialogue with participants to extract implicit domain interests, project ideas, and complementary skill needs.

nodes.label: Foundation LLM API
nodes.description: Executes profiling prompt chains, context extraction, text summarization, and pairwise conversation starter generation.

nodes.label: Embedding Generator
nodes.description: Generates dense vector embeddings for extracted participant profiles, thematic interests, and project concepts.

nodes.label: Hybrid Matching Engine
nodes.description: Computes cosine distance via pgvector combined with deterministic heuristic filters (e.g., complementary roles, team status).

nodes.label: Contextual Icebreaker Service
nodes.description: Synthesizes pairwise profile insights to craft contextual conversation prompts when two users match or scan badges.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL + pgvector
nodes.description: Primary datastore maintaining participant profiles, structured registration fields, high-dimensional vector embeddings, and connection history.

nodes.label: Redis Cache & Session Store
nodes.description: Maintains ephemeral chat session states for onboarding conversations and caches precomputed match scores and graph coordinates.

nodes.label: Organizer Registration Data
nodes.description: External attendee data sources (Luma, Typeform, Eventbrite, or CSV dumps).

mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
  subgraph External[External Inputs]
    EXT_REG[Organizer Registration Data]
  end

  subgraph Client[Client Layer]
    APP[Participant Web App / PWA]
  end

  subgraph CoreAPI[API & Coordination Layer]
    GW[API Gateway & Router]
    IMPORT[Organizer Ingest Worker]
    PROFILER[Conversational Profiler Service]
    ICEBREAKER[Contextual Icebreaker Service]
  end

  subgraph ComputeAI[Matching & AI Services]
    EMB[Embedding Generator]
    MATCH[Hybrid Matching Engine]
    LLM[Foundation LLM API]
  end

  subgraph DataLayer[Data & State Layer]
    PG[(PostgreSQL + pgvector)]
    CACHE[(Redis Cache & Session Store)]
  end

  EXT_REG -->|Batch attendee export| IMPORT
  IMPORT -->|Seed participants| PG

  APP -->|Chat, Match Requests, QR Scans| GW
  GW -->|Session routing| PROFILER
  GW -->|Fetch matches & graph| MATCH
  GW -->|QR badge resolution| ICEBREAKER

  PROFILER <-->|Session state| CACHE
  PROFILER -->|Adaptive prompts & synthesis| LLM
  PROFILER -->|Update rich profile| PG

  PG -.->|Profile change event| EMB
  EMB -->|Compute embeddings| LLM
  EMB -->|Write vectors| PG

  MATCH -->|Vector similarity + relational filter| PG
  MATCH -->|Cache top matches| CACHE

  ICEBREAKER -->|Fetch paired profile data| PG
  ICEBREAKER -->|Generate context starters| LLM
  ICEBREAKER -->|Personalized prompts| APP
